35dca570d7: The speech model download stopped or failed.
e2b9e6fb65: Check that you have a stable connection and enough free storage for 671 MB, then start the download again in the app. Wi-Fi is the safer choice.
b233f17712: Speed depends on the phone’s processor: on a Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra, one hour of audio took about 8 minutes in our test, and older phones take longer. The optional second model is slower than the main one. You can leave the app while it works.
f16401ecd1: I bought something on another phone or after reinstalling.
1190ebbc46: Open the purchase screen and tap “Restore purchases”. Use the same Google account you bought with.
09c008f0b5: How do I get a refund or cancel a subscription?
6c5859a8ab: Refunds and cancellations go through Google Play: open Google Play, then Payments and subscriptions. We cannot issue refunds ourselves.
97e56dfd58: The ad for extra minutes did not load.
1a6e0165a6: Ads need a connection and are not always available. Nothing in the app is blocked when an ad fails; try again later or use a minute pack.
82c6d933b6: Delete recordings in the app, delete the speech models in Settings, or uninstall the app to remove all of it.
9b68802e06: Write to us with any problem or question about the app.
